verses.original: Τότε ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ὁμοιωθήσεται δέκα παρθένοις αἵτινες λαβοῦσαι ἑαυτῶν τὰς λαμπάδας ἐξῆλθον εἰς ὑπάντησιν τοῦ νυμφίου
verses.transliteration: Tote hē basileia tōn ouranōn homoiōthēsetai deka parthenois haitines labousai heautōn tas lampadas exēlthon eis hypantēsin tou nymphiou
verses.literal: At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their - lamps [and] went out to meet the bridegroom

verses.original: δὲ πέντε ἐξ αὐτῶν ἦσαν μωραὶ καὶ πέντε φρόνιμοι
verses.transliteration: de pente ex autōn ēsan mōrai kai pente phronimoi
verses.literal: - Five of them were foolish and five [were] wise

verses.original: γὰρ αἱ μωραὶ λαβοῦσαι αὐτῶν τὰς λαμπάδας ἔλαβον μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν οὐκ ἔλαιον
verses.transliteration: gar hai mōrai labousai autōn tas lampadas elabon meth’ heautōn ouk elaion
verses.literal: - The foolish [ones] took their - lamps [but did not] take along . . . . . . [any extra] oil

verses.original: δὲ αἱ φρόνιμοι ἔλαβον ἔλαιον ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις μετὰ ἑαυτῶν τῶν λαμπάδων
verses.transliteration: de hai phronimoi elabon elaion en tois angeiois meta heautōn tōn lampadōn
verses.literal: But the wise [ones] took oil in - flasks along with their - lamps

verses.original: δὲ τοῦ νυμφίου χρονίζοντος πᾶσαι ἐνύσταξαν καὶ ἐκάθευδον
verses.transliteration: de tou nymphiou chronizontos pasai enystaxan kai ekatheudon
verses.literal: [When] the bridegroom was delayed vvv they all became drowsy and fell asleep

verses.original: δὲ Μέσης νυκτὸς κραυγὴ γέγονεν Ἰδοὺ ὁ νυμφίος ἐξέρχεσθε εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: de Mesēs nyktos kraugē gegonen Idou ho nymphios exerchesthe eis apantēsin autou
verses.literal: - At midnight . . . the cry rang out Here is the bridegroom Come out to meet him

verses.original: Τότε πᾶσαι ἐκεῖναι αἱ παρθένοι ἠγέρθησαν καὶ ἐκόσμησαν ἑαυτῶν τὰς λαμπάδας
verses.transliteration: Tote pasai ekeinai hai parthenoi ēgerthēsan kai ekosmēsan heautōn tas lampadas
verses.literal: Then all - the virgins woke up and trimmed their - lamps

verses.original: δὲ αἱ μωραὶ εἶπαν ταῖς φρονίμοις Δότε ἡμῖν ἐκ ὑμῶν τοῦ ἐλαίου ὅτι ἡμῶν αἱ λαμπάδες σβέννυνται
verses.transliteration: de hai mōrai eipan tais phronimois Dote hēmin ek hymōn tou elaiou hoti hēmōn hai lampades sbennyntai
verses.literal: - The foolish ones said to the wise Give us some of your - oil - our - lamps are going out

verses.original: οὐ δὲ Ἀπεκρίθησαν αἱ φρόνιμοι λέγουσαι Μή¦Ποτε μὴ ἀρκέσῃ ἡμῖν καὶ ὑμῖν μᾶλλον πορεύεσθε πρὸς τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ ἀγοράσατε ἑαυταῖς
verses.transliteration: ou de Apekrithēsan hai phronimoi legousai Mē¦Pote mē arkesē hēmin kai hymin mallon poreuesthe pros tous pōlountas kai agorasate heautais
verses.literal: No - said the wise [ones] . . . or vvv there may not be enough for [both] us and you Instead go to those who sell [oil] and buy [some] for yourselves

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν Ἀπερχομένων ἀγοράσαι ὁ νυμφίος ἦλθεν καὶ αἱ ἕτοιμοι εἰσῆλθον μετ’ αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς γάμους καὶ ἡ θύρα ἐκλείσθη
verses.transliteration: de autōn Aperchomenōn agorasai ho nymphios ēlthen kai hai hetoimoi eisēlthon met’ autou eis tous gamous kai hē thyra ekleisthē
verses.literal: But [while] they were on their way to buy [it] the bridegroom arrived - Those who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet and the door was shut

verses.original: Ὕστερον δὲ αἱ λοιπαὶ παρθένοι ἔρχονται καὶ λέγουσαι Κύριε κύριε ἄνοιξον ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Hysteron de hai loipai parthenoi erchontai kai legousai Kyrie kyrie anoixon hēmin
verses.literal: Later vvv the other virgins arrived and said Lord lord open [the door] for us

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de Ho apokritheis eipen Amēn legō hymin ouk oida hymas
verses.literal: But - he replied . . . Truly I tell you vvv I do not know you

verses.original: οὖν Γρηγορεῖτε ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἡμέραν οὐδὲ τὴν ὥραν
verses.transliteration: oun Grēgoreite hoti ouk oidate tēn hēmeran oude tēn hōran
verses.literal: Therefore keep watch because vvv you do not know the day [or] the hour

verses.original: γὰρ Ὥσπερ ἄνθρωπος ἀποδημῶν ἐκάλεσεν ἰδίους τοὺς δούλους καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοῖς αὐτοῦ τὰ ὑπάρχοντα
verses.transliteration: gar Hōsper anthrōpos apodēmōn ekalesen idious tous doulous kai paredōken autois autou ta hyparchonta
verses.literal: For [it] is just like a man going on a journey who called his - servants and entrusted them with his - possessions

verses.original: καὶ μὲν ᾧ ἔδωκεν πέντε τάλαντα δὲ ᾧ δύο δὲ ᾧ ἕν ἑκάστῳ κατὰ ἰδίαν τὴν δύναμιν καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν
verses.transliteration: kai men hō edōken pente talanta de hō dyo de hō hen hekastō kata idian tēn dynamin kai apedēmēsen
verses.literal: - - To one he gave five talents - to [another] two [talents] and to [another] one [talent] each according to his own - ability And he went on his journey

verses.original: ὁ λαβὼν τὰ πέντε τάλαντα Πορευθεὶς Εὐθέως ἠργάσατο ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐκέρδησεν πέντε ἄλλα
verses.transliteration: ho labōn ta pente talanta Poreutheis Eutheōs ērgasato en autois kai ekerdēsen pente alla
verses.literal: The [servant] who had received the five talents went at once [and] put them to work . . . . . . and gained five more

verses.original: ὡσαύτως ὁ τὰ δύο ἐκέρδησεν δύο ἄλλα
verses.transliteration: hōsautōs ho ta dyo ekerdēsen dyo alla
verses.literal: Likewise the [one with] the two [talents] gained two more

verses.original: δὲ ὁ λαβὼν τὸ ἓν ἀπελθὼν ὤρυξεν γῆν καὶ ἔκρυψεν αὐτοῦ τοῦ κυρίου τὸ ἀργύριον
verses.transliteration: de ho labōn to hen apelthōn ōryxen gēn kai ekrypsen autou tou kyriou to argyrion
verses.literal: But the [servant] who had received the one [talent] went off dug a hole in the ground and hid his - master’s - money

verses.original: δὲ Μετὰ πολὺν χρόνον ὁ κύριος ἐκείνων τῶν δούλων ἔρχεται καὶ συναίρει λόγον μετ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: de Meta polyn chronon ho kyrios ekeinōn tōn doulōn erchetai kai synairei logon met’ autōn
verses.literal: vvv After a long time the master of those - servants returned and settled accounts with them

verses.original: καὶ ὁ λαβὼν τὰ πέντε τάλαντα προσελθὼν προσήνεγκεν πέντε ἄλλα τάλαντα Κύριε λέγων παρέδωκας μοι πέντε τάλαντά ἴδε ἐκέρδησα πέντε τάλαντα ἄλλα
verses.transliteration: kai ho labōn ta pente talanta proselthōn prosēnenken pente alla talanta Kyrie legōn paredōkas moi pente talanta ide ekerdēsa pente talanta alla
verses.literal: - The [servant] who had received the five talents came [and] presented five more - Master he said you entrusted me {with} five talents See I have gained five - more

verses.original: αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος Ἔφη αὐτῷ Εὖ ἀγαθὲ καὶ πιστέ δοῦλε ἦς πιστός ἐπὶ ὀλίγα καταστήσω σε ἐπὶ πολλῶν εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν χαρὰν τοῦ σου κυρίου
verses.transliteration: autou ho kyrios Ephē autō Eu agathe kai piste doule ēs pistos epi oliga katastēsō se epi pollōn eiselthe eis tēn charan tou sou kyriou
verses.literal: His - master replied - Well done good and faithful servant You have been faithful with a few things I will put you {in charge} of many things Enter into the joy of your master

verses.original: δὲ ὁ τὰ δύο τάλαντα καὶ Προσελθὼν εἶπεν Κύριε παρέδωκας μοι δύο τάλαντά ἴδε ἐκέρδησα δύο τάλαντα ἄλλα
verses.transliteration: de ho ta dyo talanta kai Proselthōn eipen Kyrie paredōkas moi dyo talanta ide ekerdēsa dyo talanta alla
verses.literal: - The [servant] [who had received] the two talents also came [and] said Master you entrusted me {with} two talents See I have gained two - more

verses.original: αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος Ἔφη αὐτῷ Εὖ ἀγαθὲ καὶ πιστέ δοῦλε ἦς πιστός ἐπὶ ὀλίγα καταστήσω σε ἐπὶ πολλῶν εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν χαρὰν τοῦ σου κυρίου
verses.transliteration: autou ho kyrios Ephē autō Eu agathe kai piste doule ēs pistos epi oliga katastēsō se epi pollōn eiselthe eis tēn charan tou sou kyriou
verses.literal: His - master replied - Well done good and faithful servant You have been faithful with a few things I will put you {in charge} of many things Enter into the joy of your master

verses.original: δὲ ὁ εἰληφὼς τὸ ἓν τάλαντον Προσελθὼν καὶ εἶπεν Κύριε ἔγνων σε ὅτι εἶ σκληρὸς ἄνθρωπος θερίζων ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρας καὶ συνάγων ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισας
verses.transliteration: de ho eilēphōs to hen talanton Proselthōn kai eipen Kyrie egnōn se hoti ei sklēros anthrōpos therizōn hopou ouk espeiras kai synagōn hothen ou dieskorpisas
verses.literal: Finally the [servant] who had received the one talent came and said Master I knew - that you are a hard man reaping where vvv you have not sown and gathering where vvv you have not scattered seed

verses.original: καὶ φοβηθεὶς ἀπελθὼν ἔκρυψα σου τὸ τάλαντόν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἴδε ἔχεις τὸ σόν
verses.transliteration: kai phobētheis apelthōn ekrypsa sou to talanton en tē gē ide echeis to son
verses.literal: So I was afraid and went out [and] hid your - talent in the ground See you have what [belongs] to you

verses.original: Πονηρὲ καὶ ὀκνηρέ δοῦλε δὲ Ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῷ αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος ᾔδεις ὅτι θερίζω ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρα καὶ συνάγω ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισα
verses.transliteration: Ponēre kai oknēre doule de Apokritheis eipen autō autou ho kyrios ēdeis hoti therizō hopou ouk espeira kai synagō hothen ou dieskorpisa
verses.literal: You wicked - lazy servant - replied . . . . . . his - master You knew that I reap where vvv I have not sown and gather where . . . I have not scattered seed

verses.original: οὖν σε ἔδει βαλεῖν μου τὰ ἀργύριά τοῖς τραπεζίταις καὶ ἐγὼ ἐλθὼν ἂν ἐκομισάμην τὸ ἐμὸν σὺν τόκῳ
verses.transliteration: oun se edei balein mou ta argyria tois trapezitais kai egō elthōn an ekomisamēn to emon syn tokō
verses.literal: Then you should have deposited my - money with the bankers and vvv on my return vvv I would have received - it {back} with interest

verses.original: οὖν Ἄρατε τὸ τάλαντον ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ δότε τῷ ἔχοντι τὰ δέκα τάλαντα
verses.transliteration: oun Arate to talanton ap’ autou kai dote tō echonti ta deka talanta
verses.literal: Therefore take the talent from him and give [it] to the [one] who has - ten talents

verses.original: γὰρ τῷ παντὶ ἔχοντι δοθήσεται καὶ περισσευθήσεται δὲ τοῦ μὴ ἔχοντος καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar tō panti echonti dothēsetai kai perisseuthēsetai de tou mē echontos kai ho echei arthēsetai ap’ autou
verses.literal: For - everyone who has will be given [more] and [he] will have an abundance But the [one who] {does} not have even what he has will be taken away from him

verses.original: καὶ ἐκβάλετε τὸν ἀχρεῖον δοῦλον εἰς τὸ τὸ ἐξώτερον σκότος ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων
verses.transliteration: kai ekbalete ton achreion doulon eis to to exōteron skotos ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brygmos tōn odontōn
verses.literal: And throw that worthless servant into the - outer darkness [where] there will be - weeping and - gnashing of teeth

verses.original: δὲ Ὅταν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔλθῃ ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ δόξῃ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι μετ’ αὐτοῦ τότε καθίσει ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ δόξης θρόνου
verses.transliteration: de Hotan ho huios tou anthrōpou elthē en autou tē doxē kai pantes hoi angeloi met’ autou tote kathisei epi autou doxēs thronou
verses.literal: - When the Son - of Man comes in His - glory and all the angels with Him - He will sit on His glorious throne

verses.original: καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη συναχθήσονται ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀφορίσει αὐτοὺς ἀπ’ ἀλλήλων ὥσπερ ὁ ποιμὴν ἀφορίζει τὰ πρόβατα ἀπὸ τῶν ἐρίφων
verses.transliteration: kai panta ta ethnē synachthēsontai emprosthen autou kai aphorisei autous ap’ allēlōn hōsper ho poimēn aphorizei ta probata apo tōn eriphōn
verses.literal: - All the nations will be gathered before Him and He will separate [the people] vvv one from another as - a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats

verses.original: καὶ μὲν στήσει τὰ πρόβατα ἐκ αὐτοῦ δεξιῶν δὲ τὰ ἐρίφια ἐξ εὐωνύμων
verses.transliteration: kai men stēsei ta probata ek autou dexiōn de ta eriphia ex euōnymōn
verses.literal: - - He will place the sheep on His right and the goats on [His] left

verses.original: Τότε ὁ Βασιλεὺς ἐρεῖ τοῖς ἐκ αὐτοῦ δεξιῶν Δεῦτε οἱ εὐλογημένοι τοῦ μου Πατρός κληρονομήσατε τὴν βασιλείαν ἡτοιμασμένην ὑμῖν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου
verses.transliteration: Tote ho Basileus erei tois ek autou dexiōn Deute hoi eulogēmenoi tou mou Patros klēronomēsate tēn basileian hētoimasmenēn hymin apo katabolēs kosmou
verses.literal: Then the King will say to those on His right Come you who are blessed by My Father inherit the kingdom prepared for you from [the] foundation of [the] world

verses.original: γὰρ ἐπείνασα καὶ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν ἐδίψησα καὶ με ἐποτίσατέ ἤμην ξένος καὶ συνηγάγετέ με
verses.transliteration: gar epeinasa kai edōkate moi phagein edipsēsa kai me epotisate ēmēn xenos kai synēgagete me
verses.literal: For I was hungry and you gave Me [something] to eat I was thirsty and vvv you gave Me [something] to drink I was a stranger and you took Me in . . .

verses.original: γυμνὸς καὶ περιεβάλετέ με ἠσθένησα καὶ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με ἤμην ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ ἤλθατε πρός με
verses.transliteration: gymnos kai periebalete me ēsthenēsa kai epeskepsasthe me ēmēn en phylakē kai ēlthate pros me
verses.literal: [I was] naked and you clothed Me I was sick and you looked after Me I was in prison and you visited . . . Me

verses.original: Τότε οἱ δίκαιοι ἀποκριθήσονται αὐτῷ λέγοντες Κύριε πότε εἴδομεν σε πεινῶντα καὶ ἐθρέψαμεν ἢ διψῶντα καὶ ἐποτίσαμεν
verses.transliteration: Tote hoi dikaioi apokrithēsontai autō legontes Kyrie pote eidomen se peinōnta kai ethrepsamen ē dipsōnta kai epotisamen
verses.literal: Then the righteous will answer Him - Lord when did we see You hungry and feed [You] or thirsty and give [You] something to drink

verses.original: δέ πότε εἴδομεν σε ξένον καὶ συνηγάγομεν ἢ γυμνὸν καὶ περιεβάλομεν
verses.transliteration: de pote eidomen se xenon kai synēgagomen ē gymnon kai periebalomen
verses.literal: - When did we see You a stranger and take [You] in or naked and clothe [You]

verses.original: δέ πότε εἴδομεν σε ἀσθενοῦντα ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ ἤλθομεν πρός σε
verses.transliteration: de pote eidomen se asthenounta ē en phylakē kai ēlthomen pros se
verses.literal: - When did we see You sick or in prison and visit . . . You

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Βασιλεὺς ἀποκριθεὶς ἐρεῖ αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἐφ’ ὅσον ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τῶν ἐλαχίστων τούτων τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου ἐποιήσατε ἐμοὶ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Basileus apokritheis erei autois Amēn legō hymin eph’ hoson epoiēsate heni tōn elachistōn toutōn tōn adelphōn mou epoiēsate emoi
verses.literal: And the King vvv will reply . . . Truly I tell you whatever . . . you did for one of the least of these - brothers of Mine you did for Me

verses.original: Τότε καὶ ἐρεῖ τοῖς ἐξ εὐωνύμων Πορεύεσθε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ οἱ κατηραμένοι εἰς τὸ τὸ αἰώνιον πῦρ τὸ ἡτοιμασμένον τῷ διαβόλῳ καὶ αὐτοῦ τοῖς ἀγγέλοις
verses.transliteration: Tote kai erei tois ex euōnymōn Poreuesthe ap’ emou hoi katēramenoi eis to to aiōnion pyr to hētoimasmenon tō diabolō kai autou tois angelois
verses.literal: Then - He will say to those on [His] left Depart from Me [you] who are cursed into the - eternal fire - prepared for the devil and his - angels

verses.original: γὰρ ἐπείνασα καὶ ἐδώκατέ μοι οὐκ φαγεῖν καὶ ἐδίψησα καὶ ἐποτίσατέ οὐκ με
verses.transliteration: gar epeinasa kai edōkate moi ouk phagein kai edipsēsa kai epotisate ouk me
verses.literal: For I was hungry and you gave Me nothing to eat - I was thirsty and you gave Me nothing to drink . . . . . .

verses.original: ἤμην ξένος καὶ οὐ συνηγάγετέ με γυμνὸς καὶ οὐ περιεβάλετέ με ἀσθενὴς καὶ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐκ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με
verses.transliteration: ēmēn xenos kai ou synēgagete me gymnos kai ou periebalete me asthenēs kai en phylakē kai ouk epeskepsasthe me
verses.literal: I was a stranger and vvv you did not take Me in . . . [I was] naked and vvv you did not clothe Me [I was] sick and in prison and vvv you did not look after Me

verses.original: Τότε αὐτοὶ καὶ ἀποκριθήσονται λέγοντες Κύριε πότε εἴδομεν σε πεινῶντα ἢ διψῶντα ἢ ξένον ἢ γυμνὸν ἢ ἀσθενῆ ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐ διηκονήσαμέν σοι
verses.transliteration: Tote autoi kai apokrithēsontai legontes Kyrie pote eidomen se peinōnta ē dipsōnta ē xenon ē gymnon ē asthenē ē en phylakē kai ou diēkonēsamen soi
verses.literal: And they too will reply - Lord when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison and vvv did not minister to You

verses.original: Τότε ἀποκριθήσεται αὐτοῖς λέγων Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἐφ’ ὅσον οὐκ ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τῶν ἐλαχίστων τούτων οὐδὲ ἐποιήσατε ἐμοὶ
verses.transliteration: Tote apokrithēsetai autois legōn Amēn legō hymin eph’ hoson ouk epoiēsate heni tōn elachistōn toutōn oude epoiēsate emoi
verses.literal: Then [the King] will answer . . . - Truly I tell you whatever . . . vvv you did not do for one of the least of these vvv you did not do for Me

verses.original: Καὶ οὗτοι ἀπελεύσονται εἰς αἰώνιον κόλασιν δὲ οἱ δίκαιοι εἰς αἰώνιον ζωὴν
verses.transliteration: Kai houtoi apeleusontai eis aiōnion kolasin de hoi dikaioi eis aiōnion zōēn
verses.literal: And they will go away into eternal punishment but the righteous into eternal life
